description: Bench S8, the leadership reference (M3 step 10, battle-sim.md §13): S6's two lines of 8 marching into each other head-on, but one man of the Hird line is Hrafn, an experienced Retainer in the same kit, in its front rank — the only difference from S6 is his leadership (experienced: 100 ‰ off every morale loss of his squad, faster recovery) and his fall costing as one mate (decided 2026-11-26). Batch it against S6 to see what a leader is worth; BalanceReferenceTests pins it. Don't edit it to play.
